statements.status_notes: Netty is a transitive dependency of AWS SDK. As discussed in this thread https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-java-v2/issues/4619, netty is used by the SDK as a client, not a server. Hence, this CVE cannot be exploited.

PF 12.1 does indeed have version 4.1.84Final. Although this version of Netty has a known vulnerability, PingFederate is not impacted because the issue pertains to servers affected by the HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack. PingFederate uses Netty as a client to interact with AWS services, and the vulnerability primarily targets server-side implementations.

PF 12.2 will be shipped with version 4.1.108Final.
